using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

const int MAXN = 510;
int N, M, MOD;
int fact[MAXN], invNum[MAXN], invFact[MAXN];
int F[MAXN], C[MAXN];
int dp1[MAXN][MAXN], dp2[MAXN][MAXN];

inline int add_mod(int a, int b) { a += b; if(a >= MOD) a -= MOD; return a; }
inline int mul_mod(int a, int b) { return (int)(1LL * a * b % MOD); }

void precompute() {
    fact[0] = fact[1] = invNum[1] = invFact[0] = invFact[1] = 1;
    for(int i = 2; i < MAXN; i++) {
        fact[i] = mul_mod(fact[i-1], i);
        invNum[i] = MOD - mul_mod(MOD / i, invNum[MOD % i]);
        invFact[i] = mul_mod(invFact[i-1], invNum[i]);
    }
}

inline int choose(int n, int k) {
    return mul_mod(fact[n], mul_mod(invFact[k], invFact[n-k]));
}

inline ll p(int x) { return 1LL * x * (x + 1) / 2; }

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cout.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;
    precompute();

    F[0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
        for(int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            F[i] = add_mod(F[i], mul_mod(mul_mod(choose(i-1, j), F[j]), F[i-1-j]));
            C[i] = add_mod(C[i], mul_mod(mul_mod(i+1, choose(i-1, j)),
                         add_mod(mul_mod(F[j], C[i-1-j]), mul_mod(F[i-1-j], C[j]))));
            C[i] = add_mod(C[i], mul_mod(mul_mod(choose(i-1, j), (p(j) + p(i-1-j)) % MOD),
                         mul_mod(F[j], F[i-1-j])));
        }
        F[i] = mul_mod(F[i], i+1);
    }

    dp1[0][0] = 1;
    for(int k = 1; k <= N; k++) {
        dp1[k][0] = 1;
        for(int i = 1; i <= min(M, k); i++) {
            dp1[k][i] = dp1[k-1][i];
            dp2[k][i] = dp2[k-1][i];
            for(int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                dp1[k][i] = add_mod(dp1[k][i], mul_mod(mul_mod(F[j], dp1[max(k-j-1, 0)][i-j]), choose(i, j)));
                dp2[k][i] = add_mod(dp2[k][i], mul_mod(mul_mod(C[j], dp1[max(k-j-1, 0)][i-j]), choose(i, j)));
                dp2[k][i] = add_mod(dp2[k][i], mul_mod(mul_mod(F[j], dp2[max(k-j-1, 0)][i-j]), choose(i, j)));
